items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I had a get together band, and Eureka played two bands.

ctx.x: Well say a funeral like Buddy Petit's funeral, who would play that?
I had a get together band, and Eureka played two bands. Louis Armstrong was part there. That's the time he was here at the Suburban Garden.
Do you remember who you had in your band?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: See when I met him, first time I met him it was in Bugalusa.

ctx.x: Was he a sort of rough or sweet style or what?

Sweet but good. Good. See when I met him, first time I met him it was in Bugalusa. Yeah. Bugalusa. And he was playing a lot of horn then. After that he came back home here and played a trumpet. No way he wasn't too much with that mute. I mean he didn't use that, he played, but he could fingers so good. Yeah.
Did he play very loud or soft mostly or what was it? Very?
